profile.headline: Staff Software engineer at Uniphore
profile.summary:
- Well acquainted with Software Development Life Cycle and Test Methodologies.
	Actively involved in the development of test plan, test cases and executing the test cases based on the Business requirement and Technical Specifications.
	Extensive experience in writing test scripts for Black Box Testing.
	Involved in Manual, Automated Testing of applications in windows Environment.
	Proficient in Automation Tool - Selenium with Ruby/C#, Watir with Ruby, Cucumber with Ruby, QTP(Beginner), AutoIt.
	Communicating with client and developing team members.
	Extensive experience in testing of backend process with database. 
	Expertise in create bug documents and handling Bug life cycle
	Good interpersonal skills, commitment, result oriented, hard working with a quest and zeal to learn new technologies and undertake challenging tasks.
	Self starter, Self motivated and quick learner.
	Versatile Team player with good communications and Problem solving skills.
